Authenticated account/settings contain no overlay webviews. Candidate integrated browser stays with its separate privileged capability and migration.

Preserve toolbar hover fill, active fill, disabled exclusion and inset dashed hover outline together in the Proctor-owned action surfaces. Keyboard focus retains its owning solid focus indicator.

dependencies.rationale: Existing workbench-kernel interface owns fixed regions, visibility, layout lifecycle, focus and composition-controlled resizing. AuthenticatedWindow disables region resizing. Compatible input state; no imported upstream service graph.
Existing theme service supplies the packaged catalog and four scheme classifications, semantic gap/gutter/inset tokens, density and preference lifecycle.
Existing ResizeObserver measures the allocated inner content box and delegates dimensions through WorkbenchPane.layout.

dependencies.reference: CSS Grid, border-box sizing, ResizeObserver, MutationObserver and DOM pointer capture
dependencies.rationale: Browser layout preserves intrinsic reflow and subtracts insets before pane measurement; shell disposes observations and active drags.

divergences.summary: Proctor retains its admitted fixed navigation/context sidebar/content topology and optional bottom panel. No arbitrary docking, auxiliary editor windows, extension views, agent panes, webviews or experiment settings are imported. AuthenticatedWindow is migrated here; Candidate and Launch behavior are preserved.

CSS Grid and border-box apply floating margins/borders to each original grid slot before PaneHost measurement. This replaces upstream imperative grid dimension subtraction without losing density/seam/visibility geometry. At constrained width, product navigation has a focus-safe titlebar disclosure instead of squeezing account pages.

Profile, Sessions and Settings remain Proctor-owned account pages. Their shell surface uses the semantic contained surface, their content shares one inset rhythm, custom scrollbars are 8px, and the bottom account menu remains a native macOS popup. No new user object editing or remote action is introduced. Row hover uses the upstream contrastActiveBorder dashed inset outline; toolbar hover uses toolbar.hoverOutline, with solid keyboard-focus precedence.

verification.obligation: All themes, default/compact gaps, perimeter and corner painting, single rail seams, hidden sidebar, fixed section sizing without resize handles, RTL, narrow 200%-equivalent viewport, focus restoration and no repeated inset shrinkage.
Account loading, mutation confirmation/cancellation, focus, disposal and constrained-width profile behavior through production pane.
No new privileged capabilities, arbitrary imports, experiment or agent products.
Compare running VS Code Insiders with rebuilt native AuthenticatedWindow. Record unavailable platform/screen-reader release evidence without claiming pixel identity.
Resolve every source blob at the pinned revision and inspect adapted differences.
